[Review Number 480] I play some Aniimo and give my opinion throughout... How does the game compare to similar open world creature collector games like Palworld or Pokémon Legends: Arceus? Is it worth buying or playing?

0:00 Verdict

Steam description: "Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities.
